metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · John Candy: I Like Me
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of iconic funnyman John Candy, who died of a heart attack in 1994, at age 43.

metas.name: ★ 9.3 · 2026 · You Can See Everything
metas.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait becomes a mind-bending three-year journey.
